capabilities: Embed Overboard boards in notes with a fenced code block or command
Edit boards inline without leaving the note
Generate flow charts and mind maps from a sentence with AI
Collaborate in real time with up to 500 teammates
Open new boards in the browser
extras: Pricing: free with full AI access; Pro $0.99/mo, Enterprise $1.99/mo. Install is manual until accepted into the community plugins directory. README notes the iframe is sandboxed and all board logic runs on Overboard's servers.
problem: Obsidian notes can't embed an interactive whiteboard, so users must switch to a browser tab to sketch or brainstorm on a canvas.

relations.evidence: Embed AI whiteboards from overboard.studio in your notes.

summary: Embeds Overboard Studio AI whiteboards in notes via code blocks, with inline editing, AI diagram generation, and real-time collaboration.
